events.wandering_collector.message.visit: A figure wrapped in tattered robes approaches. 'I sense value among your possessions,' he murmurs. 'Sell me one, or buy back what others left behind.'
A figure wrapped in tattered robes approaches, a satchel of discarded relics at his side. 'I gather what others refuse,' he murmurs. 'Any of these can be yours.'
The robed figure returns, silent as before. 'Sell me another,' he whispers, 'or claim one I found.'
The robed figure returns with forgotten relics. 'What others once refused, I kept,' he whispers. 'Any may be yours.'
